stories.title: Persona 1 Remake Footage Seemingly Leaks Online
stories.summary: What appears to be gameplay footage from an unannounced Persona 1 remake has leaked online.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Persona 1 Remake Footage Seemingly Leaks Online
sources.text: What appears to be gameplay footage from an unannounced Persona 1 remake has leaked online. A little less than two minutes of video depicting what looks like a modern version of Sega and Atlus' original Persona game was first shared by a YouTube channel using the name P1REMAKE and was eventually picked up across social media platforms like Reddit . The YouTube account it's tied to was created in March 2010 and has seemingly posted just two other videos, with its previous upload published more than 14 years ago. The developers behind the RPG franchise have broached the topic of remakes for early installments in the past but never confirmed work was underway, meaning this could be our first look at the series' next remake. In the age of AI-generated fakes, you can never be too skeptical about things like this, but fans generally seem to be under the impression that the footage is authentic. While we won't share it here, you don't have to look too hard to see what everyone's talking about. Yea that Persona 1 remake leaked footage gotta be 100% real. I refuse to believe someone would do that much work to make a fake leak. There are a few reasons players suspect this to be our first glimpse at a not-so-secret Persona 1 remake from Atlus. Aside from the music, effects, and art, which all fall right in line with much of the studio's recent work, the video on display is much longer and more detailed than any fake leak would typically be. The smoking gun for many, though, is the character animations. It's specifically Eriko that people are calling out, as she seems to share a summoning animation with Persona 4 Revival 's version of Yukiko. Atlus' Persona 4 remake, of course, won't be out until February 18, 2027. There's also the issue of the appearance of Persona 2 protagonist Tatsuya, who seems to be standing in for what may be an unfinished character model. So, what can we make of all of this? Well, unfortunately, without confirmation from Sega or Atlus, not much. There is always the chance this could be an elaborate fake, with some of these odd details serving as evidence for that argument. On the other hand, it's possible placeholder assets and familiar animations are here specifically because the alleged Persona 1 remake is still very much in development. Persona 1 leak looks credible, not sure why people are reporting Tatsuya is replacing Masao, that's just complete bogus. This is most likely an internal investor pitch for remakes of Persona 1 and 2, and not actually Persona 1. There are Persona 4 Revival animations in the gameplay footage, which definitely helps the case of it being real. That sure is a persona 1 remake trailer. Why is tatsuya there We don't know when this footage would have been captured, even if it does turn out to be real. That means this could be from yesterday or years ago, with some speculating that the video we've seen today is little more than a proof-of-concept or pitch video. If the Persona: Be Your True Mind remake footage is authentic, it wouldn't be the biggest surprise to see it announced. Sega released its Persona 3 remake, Persona 3 Reload , in 2024, and will release Persona 4 Revival in just a few months. Atlus' P-Studio producer, Kazuhisa Wada, stopped short of confirming development for Persona 1 and 2 remakes in August of this year but still admitted that, as far as he's concerned, it's something "we have to do." Meanwhile, Atlus has absolutely suffered leaks before. The Persona 3 remake had in-development footage questioned by fans when it showed up online back in 2023. The upcoming Persona 6 , which, officially, we've seen little of so far, had images leak in June. A massive Steam leak in September then seemingly revealed a list of trophies – including story spoilers – for the upcoming installment. Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: Rumor: Persona remake footage appears online
sources.text: A video reel showcasing what appears to be work-in-progress footage of a Revelations: Persona remake has surfaced online. The footage, a showreel similar to the one showcasing footage of Persona 3 Reload that leaked prior to its announcement, features three sections of the game—field, battle, and event scenes built around 2D illustrations. Persona 2: Innocent Sin protagonist Tatsuya Suou appears in the battle section of the footage. However, since he does not appear in Revelations: Persona , he may be a stand-in for another character. It’is also possible that remakes of Persona 2: Innocent Sin and / or Persona 2: Eternal Punishment are simultaneously in development. Other things worth noting are the constant appearance of Unreal Engine debut text in the upper-left corner of the screen and the fact that Eriko Kirishima appears to use the same Persona summon animation as Yukiko Amagi in Persona 4 Revival , lending the footage further credibility. As for the source of the footage, it was originally posted to YouTube by a user named “P1REMAKE” today at 2:25 a.m. PT / 5:25 a.m. ET . As of press time, the YouTube video remains accessible, but copies have also been hosted on file-sharing websites such as Gofile and Catbox , and shared in communities like r/GamingLeaksAndRumours . The YouTube account was created in March 2010 and has only ever posted two other videos, though its username was likely changed to “P1REMAKE” around the time the footage was posted.

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Two minutes of Persona 1 remake footage seemingly leaks online
sources.text: Two minutes of footage from an unannounced turn-based RPG recently spilled online, and yep, it very much looks like a remake of the very first Persona game. A YouTube account aptly called 'P1REMAKE' only yesterday posted a little under two minutes of footage from what appears to be a Persona 1 remake. As expected, eagle-eyed fans quickly spotted the clip and soon spread it across several other social media platforms, with the footage since appearing on Reddit and X. Of course, you should take all leaks with an unhealthily huge handful of salt no matter how convincing they look - especially in the age of generative-AI videos and such. At the same time, there are quite a few good reasons to let yourself be a little hopeful for this remake. For one, the two-minute clip is longer and more elaborate than gen-AI videos typically are. Several series fans have also pointed out the video shows Eriko summoning her Persona in combat, while using the exact same animation as Persona 4 Revival's version of bestie Yukiko. Revival doesn't actually launch until next year, which makes the pose quite suspicious. Then there's the fact that this type of leak isn't exactly new territory for Atlus' popular role-playing franchise. In 2023, footage from what ended up being called Persona 3 Reload leaked online and showed very similarly rough, clearly in-development scenes from the game's dungeons. One other curiosity is the inclusion of Tatsuya, the protagonist from Persona 2 Innocent Sin, who doesn't actually show up in the series' first game. Some folks are speculating that the video might have been created as an internal proof-of-concept pitch for Sega and Atlus management, so Tatsuya would serve as a placeholder model in that case. A Persona 1 remake isn't entirely unlikely with or without this potential leak, either. Persona series producer Kazuhisa Wada recently said remakes of the first two games are "probably eventually" happening at some point in the future. He particularly enjoys writing about spooky indies, throwback RPGs, and anything that's vaguely silly. Also has an English Literature and Film Studies degree that he'll soon forget. sources.title: The Journey of Crimson Desert Continues with Charting the Unknown
sources.text: Since its launch in March, the world of Crimson Desert — where Kliff and the Greymanes fight to rebuild what they lost — has grown with each update. Alongside improvements, the game has received brand new content, including boss rematches, and new features shaped by players’ adventures and stories across Pywel. In August, we released Patch Version 2.00. The free update added new story moments and expanded voice-over and language support. Together with all the post-launch updates up to that date, the update came out as Crimson Desert Enhanced . Lastly, with the launch of Charting the Unknown on October 29, Pywel is growing once again with even more adventures. The DLC brings new journeys across land and, for the first time, at sea, along with new ways to enrich your life in Pywel. Charting the Unknown is available now on XBOX Series X|S. We want to thank all our Greymanes out there for the incredible support they have shown for Crimson Desert since launch. Your love for the game has brought us this far, and we are excited for you to experience what the DLC has to offer. Now, let’s take a look at what awaits you in Charting the Unknown. Charting the Unknown introduces three new storylines, one each for Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane. With the fight for the Greymanes and Pywel behind them, each character sets out to forge their own path. Along the way, they will meet allies and threats both old and new, and chart their own course forward. The DLC brings something many players have been asking for: ocean exploration. Dive into the sea and explore the underwater world, where you will discover ruins, treasure chests, and new creatures and mounts. You can also build your own ship and set sail across the Great Ocean of Pywel. Charting the Unknown also deepens life in the world. Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane can form deeper bonds with some of Pywel’s inhabitants. Interact with them to build trust and strengthen your relationship, which may eventually blossom into romance and even marriage. An upgraded housing system now lets you build your house from the ground up. And from the layout of the interior to the placement of walls, windows, and other structural elements, you have more control than ever to design your home, sweet home. There’s more: select castles, once liberated, can become yours. This will allow you to decorate their courtyards and interiors with unique objects and furnishings, turning a hard-won stronghold into another place you can call your own. Also, if you want to take a more active role in the strongholds you have liberated, you can lease certain facilities such as a restaurant or a smithy and run them yourself. Assign equipment and comrades, decide which goods to sell, and grow each location’s recognition. For those who don’t always like life too peaceful, Charting the Unknown has new content for you. The Garden of Trials is a combat-focused challenge where you face the bosses you have met throughout your adventures in Pywel, one after another. So test your skills and mettle to see if you hold up against these formidable foes. Whether you are a seasoned Greymane or just taking your first steps in Pywel, there is plenty to discover. And if you have not set out on the journey yet, this is the perfect time to do so! Crimson Desert is offering a 5-hour free trial of the base game for XBOX players from October 29 through January 6, so take the opportunity to step into Pywel and reach beyond!

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown Review So Far
sources.text: Crimson Desert’s biggest strength is in the sheer volume of stuff it throws at you, allowing you to spend hundreds or even a thousand-plus hours doing everything from hunting animals with a bow to developing a gambling addiction at the tavern. So it’s not very surprising that Crimson Desert’s first paid DLC, called Charting the Unknown, prioritizes adding more on top of its already staggeringly large repertoire. So far, the interesting new activities that mostly focus on oceanic adventures are exactly as compelling as you’d hope, with ship-to-ship combat, underwater exploration, and romance options being among the list of new worthwhile features. On the other hand, existing activities that have added content, like the extra story missions, have mostly been uninspired retreads that don’t do anything to improve upon their established shortcomings. When Crimson Desert came out, I said that its content was a mile long and an inch deep, and for better or worse this DLC seems to say, “Here’s another half-mile.” The most disappointing part of the DLC so far has been the additional story missions, which are only accessible once you’ve completed the base game’s already dense main story (a feat which only 10% of Steam players have done, judging by the achievements system). At least the handful of missions I’ve completed at this point have mostly served as an expanded epilogue of sorts, with Kliff fighting more difficult versions of old bosses from the existing story, and Damiane and Oongka fleshing out their less substantial stories as well. I’m not far enough to know if any of these quests eventually become more interesting, but most of their objectives have been an oddly bland retracing of your steps, like going back to spend time with a familiar character and share a moment fishing together or arm wrestle someone to gather information as an apparent callback to an identical moment in the original story. I did get to a new stretch of the map just before getting distracted by the separate seafaring content, so hopefully this part of the DLC will pick up the pace, but so far it’s been about as unimpressive as I expected given the low bar for storytelling in Crimson Desert. Much like the base content though, most of the effort seems to have been put into things that aren’t related to the story. Although most of my time has been spent dipping my toes into the water-based ship-crafting feature that’s the focus of this expansion, it feels like I’ve only seen the tip of the iceberg, with new resources to obtain, crewmates to hire, and even more activities to learn like harpooning fish and ship-to-ship combat before you can really begin your voyages properly. It's going to take more time to fully engage with these new activities and judge whether or not they have the sea legs to keep me entertained for longer than a few hours, but at least right now I’m just impressed (yet again) by the fact that these systems exist in this adventure that’s already so damn packed with things to do. Gliding underwater on the back of a sea turtle and captaining your own pirate crew truly just feel completely bizarre in the context of Crimson Desert, and so far that’s been compelling enough to keep me moving forward even if some of the other added content isn’t great. There’s still a ton I have to investigate, like additional base building and property management features, a challenging combat arena-style gauntlet, and my personal favorite – social links and romance mechanics for NPCs, which I’m very excited to check out once I’ve gotten my bearings (I’m just not ready to settle down yet, okay?!). For all the stuff that’s been added, one thing that is the same since the last time I played is the number of bugs I’ve encountered in my brief time with the Charting the Unknown DLC. I’ve already had two hard crashes, one character wig out on me while I was trying to arm wrestle him (he was hilariously standing behind me during the match, arm bent unnaturally), and quite a few blurry or flickering textures that are impossible for me to not focus on during cutscenes. I’m still too early to tell if this is going to be a consistent issue, but in my time so far it’s been quite rocky from a technical perspective considering how much wonkiness I’ve encountered per hour played. As expected with Crimson Desert, it’s going to take quite a bit of time to see and do enough to reach a definitive conclusion on Charting the Unknown, and I’m hopeful that the engaging and unexpected content that’s been added will be able to make up for some of the activities that feel like empty calories. Travis Northup is a writer for IGN. You can follow him on Twitter @TieGuyTravis and read his games coverage here .

Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! ZERO PARADES: Director’s Cut – November 3 XBOX Play Anywhere From the creators of Disco Elysium comes ZERO PARADES – an espionage RPG. You’re a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Gather your broken network, untangle a web of lies, and prove yourself on the world stage – or blow it all up again. GRAVHOUNDS (Game Preview) – November 2 Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger… and the rewards. PIT OF GOBLIN – November 3 Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Ever dreamt of being the lowest of the low, living a life so nasty and gnarly that even the rats look down on you? Well, in Pit of Goblin , that’s every day! Slap on your stinkiest boots and dive into crumbling crypts, ghastly caverns, and ghost-infested ruins. Every step is fraught with peril and surprise! Your purpose is feeding the King Queen’s bottomless gut. The best part? You can drag your goblin buddies along for the misery! VOID/BREAKER (1.0) – November 4 Game Pass You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner – forced to fight, die, and repeat. The machines think you’ll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here. This isn’t just shooting – it’s pure velocity. Run through relentless gunfights with fluid movement designed for high-paced action. Outmaneuver your enemies and dominate every firefight with agility and speed. Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School – November 5 Game Pass Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School ! Explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings. Play solo or grab a friend and start solving in online or local co-op. Football Manager 27 (PC Early Access) – November 3 Game Pass Focus meets flow in FM27 , delivering an evolved, easier to navigate experience, with new and returning features that invite discovery from the moment your save begins. Pre-orders on PC, Game Pass Ultimate, and PC Game Pass will grant early access starting on November 3. Build, manage, and grow your very own bowling alley! Bowling Alley Simulator puts you in charge of every detail—from running the lanes to flipping burgers and keeping customers happy. Start small, make smart decisions, and turn your humble alley into a thriving entertainment hotspot. Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets ! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle! Become a tracker of mythical beings and supernatural forces. Wield the power of the fire of time, explore an ancient land, solve unusual riddles, and experience extraordinary adventures, all part of a greater, captivating story. Find your target, bring order to the chaos of time in the mysterious village, and uncover the secrets that lie within! The End of the Sun is a mystery-filled first-person adventure and exploration game set in a Slavic fantasy world. The core gameplay focuses on discovering an open world using a magical map and forming connections with bonfires. Each bond reveals new traces and events invisible to ordinary people. Fully kindled bonfires become gateways to time travel. Hidden Cats in Beijing – November 4 XBOX Play Anywhere Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing’s hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor’s palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city! Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing! Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music. Honey Route is a relaxing path-connection puzzle set inside a beehive. Rotate the hexagonal honeycomb pieces to build continuous honey trails, guiding every worker bee to a queen. Start with a single bee and a single queen, and work your way up to huge hives where many bees and many queens share the same network. One bee can reach several queens, and several bees can reach the same queen. Kingdom of Night is an ‘80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror. When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever. Outbreak: Dead City – November 4 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Or maybe not… Maybe we’ll both suffer horribly… How should I know? sources.title: All XBOX Game Pass Games Coming in November 2026
sources.text: There’s something big on the horizon, and yes, I’m talking about Grand Theft Auto 6. But just because the most anticipated game in history is coming out doesn’t mean that XBOX is sleeping on the Game Pass service. There is a stack of new games coming to Game Pass this month, from survival and simulation titles to strategy and PvP-focused games. There’s a lot on the way. Below, you’ll find a sprint through all the new games hitting XBOX Game Pass in November 2026, which can either tide you over until Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out or act as a viable alternative to Rockstar’s open-world crime epic. Perhaps you’re not interested in GTA 6; who knows? Gravhounds is a new survival-strategy shooter from Octopus Panic, and it’s basically Helldivers but with dogs . You assume control of a pack of genetically augmented canines sent to alien planets to secure resources, fight waves of enemies, amass an arsenal, and then extract again without succumbing to the infinite hordes. Football Manager is perhaps the greatest soccer simulation game ever made. It’s a title that doesn’t need too much of an introduction, but this year’s release is perhaps the most important in a long time, given how shaky the reception was for Football Manager 26. Will this year’s release turn things around? Pit of Goblin is a retro-themed dungeon-diver title with an online cooperative operating model. You assume control of nasty little goblins ransacking dungeons and trying to stay alive while amassing scraps of food to offer to your Goblin King-Queen Voidbreaker, which is often written as VOID/BREAKER, is a roguelite FPS with an insanely fast pace. It’s a high-octane, energetic shooter with an endless cycle that encourages players to experiment with near-unlimited weapon-based opportunities as they slaughter waves of AI enemies. Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School is a puzzle game that places players on an all-new campus and challenges them to uncover a mystery plaguing the school. There are scores of escape rooms to contend with, a living campus to explore, and multiple avenues to a cooperative operating model that encourages multiplayer madness. Tanuki: Pon’s Summer is a cute and cosy title that has you control an adorable raccoon named Tanuki. The twist here is that Tanuki is a postman who cycles around delivering packages and making friends, working to prepare a legendary shrine for an upcoming festival. Warhammer Survivors is an all-new bullet- heaven title with charming retro visuals that throws players into massive, overwhelming arenas with thousands of enemies to slay. You’ll control more than 40 iconic characters from across the Warhammer universe and survive endless arrays of enemies as you level up your abilities. Hope in the City is an emotional, narrative-driven game starring a teenager whose parents have gone missing from her ransacked home. You’ll need to solve puzzles and work through a curious campaign to discover what has happened to your family. Thronefall has been around for a while, but it’s coming to XBOX Game Pass in November for Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers. In this title, which is rated ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ on Steam, you’ll build and defend a kingdom, fighting waves of enemies and shoring up your defenses across a vast land built with a minimalist aesthetic in mind. Arkheron is the first game to launch on XBOX Game Pass after GTA 6 comes out, and it’s the final Game Pass game in November 2026! In Arkheron, you embark on an isometric PvP-driven adventure through a world bursting with loot opportunities and fearsome enemies. There’s strategy, a fast pace, and incredible combat visuals waiting to be discovered. What XBOX Game Pass game are you most looking forward to from November? Let us know on the Insider Gaming Discord server . For more Insider Gaming coverage, check out how GTA 6 could ‘save you thousands’ , and for even more Insider Gaming delivered directly to your inbox, sign up for our newsletter Grant has been gaming for 30+ years and in the industry for 10+. You'll probably find him playing a post-apocalyptic game or an extraction shooter somewhere.

Dos criadores de Disco Elysium , chega ZERO PARADES – um RPG de espionagem. Você é um agente brilhante, mas atormentado, em uma última e desesperada missão. Reúna sua rede de contatos desfeita, desvende uma teia de mentiras e prove seu valor no cenário mundial – ou mande tudo pelos ares de novo. 2 de novembro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere GRAVHOUNDS é um jogo cooperativo de ação e construção para 1 a 4 jogadores. Comece pequeno, tome decisões inteligentes e transforme seu modesto boliche em um centro de entretenimento de sucesso. Torne-se um rastreador de seres míticos e forças sobrenaturais. The End of the Sun é um jogo de aventura e exploração em primeira pessoa repleto de mistérios, ambientado em um mundo de fantasia eslava. A jogabilidade se concentra em explorar um mundo aberto usando um mapa mágico e estabelecendo vínculos com fogueiras. Cada vínculo revela novos vestígios e acontecimentos invisíveis às pessoas comuns. Fogueiras completamente acesas se tornam portais para viagens no tempo. Séculos atrás, os ancestrais dos gatos escondidos de Pequim percorreram a lendária Rota da Seda para chegar ao palácio do imperador. Agora, eles estão escondidos por toda a cidade! Relaxe e aproveite uma viagem ao Extremo Oriente para encontrar mais de 700 gatos escondidos em Pequim! Celebre o Festival da Primavera dando nova vida às danças do dragão e às lendas antigas, tudo ao ritmo da música tradicional chinesa. Honey Route é um jogo relaxante de quebra-cabeças de conexão de caminhos ambientado dentro de uma colmeia. Gire as peças hexagonais do favo para criar trilhas contínuas de mel, guiando cada abelha operária até uma rainha. Comece com uma única abelha e uma única rainha e avance até chegar a enormes colmeias, onde várias abelhas e rainhas compartilham a mesma rede de caminhos. Uma abelha pode chegar a várias rainhas, e várias abelhas podem chegar à mesma rainha. Kingdom of Night é um RPG de ação isométrico inspirado nos anos 80, que mistura o drama do amadurecimento com o horror cósmico. Quando um culto satânico liberta o mal ancestral Baphomet na pequena cidade de Miami, nos EUA, John, um estudante do ensino médio, precisa enfrentar uma noite de caos demoníaco para resgatar seus amigos antes que a cidade esteja perdida para sempre. 4 de novembro – Entrega Inteligente / XBOX Play Anywhere Sobreviva como um soldado enviado para conter a ameaça zumbi e encontrar uma vacina para salvar a humanidade! Junte-se à equipe de forças especiais H.A.D.E.S. em uma incursão a uma cidade tomada por zumbis, na esperança de recuperar pesquisas valiosas, evacuar um cientista essencial e, quem sabe, até encontrar uma vacina para pôr fim ao apocalipse! Outbreak: Dead City é um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa com narrativa cinematográfica e visual 3D em estilo low-poly

sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Ubisoft não tem nenhum remake de Assassin’s Creed em desenvolvimento atualmente
sources.text: Apesar da boa recepção de Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced , a Ubisoft confirmou que não possui outros remakes da franquia em desenvolvimento atualmente. Em atualização publicada na última quinta (29), a empresa comentou o aprendizado com o projeto e explicou que suas equipes estão concentradas nos próximos capítulos da série. A desenvolvedora também destacou que o sucesso de Resynced mostrou o interesse dos jogadores em revisitar aventuras clássicas. No entanto, a possibilidade de novos remakes não foi descartada — já que a Ubisoft pretende continuar avaliando oportunidades para trazer alguns clássicos de volta. A Ubisoft afirmou que desenvolver Black Flag Resynced foi uma experiência importante para entender os desafios de reconstruir um jogo querido pelos fãs. O trabalho envolveu refazer sistemas antigos, adicionar novos elementos e equilibrar as mudanças com a identidade da aventura original. “Reconstruir sistemas antigos do zero, adicionar novos elementos que se encaixam na experiência e equilibrar o legado com a inovação foi uma tarefa gigantesca”, explicou a gigante francesa. A desenvolvedora também declarou estar orgulhosa do resultado entregue pela equipe responsável pelo projeto. Apesar da recepção positiva, a Ubisoft foi direta ao esclarecer que não há outro remake de Assassin’s Creed em produção neste momento. “Nossas equipes já estão focadas no próximo capítulo da franquia Assassin’s Creed , incluindo projetos que vocês ainda não conhecem, com novos cenários e histórias”, afirmou. Isso não significa, porém, que a empresa tenha abandonado a ideia de revisitar outros títulos. A Ubisoft declarou que gosta da possibilidade de recuperar aventuras antigas e continuará avaliando oportunidades para desenvolver novos remakes no futuro. A franquia também passa por uma reorganização de sua liderança. Liderada por Martin Schelling, a nova equipe responsável por Assassin’s Creed trabalha na definição das prioridades e da visão de longo prazo para os próximos anos da série. Entre os objetivos apresentados pela Ubisoft estão preservar a identidade da franquia, continuar inovando, oferecer experiências variadas e melhorar a qualidade e a consistência dos lançamentos. A empresa também pretende manter uma narrativa mais coesa e respeitar os elementos que definem o universo da série. A desenvolvedora afirmou que milhares de jogadores participaram de uma pesquisa comunitária realizada em março. Entre os principais pontos levantados estavam a preservação dos pilares da franquia, o desenvolvimento de histórias mais conectadas e a necessidade de uma comunicação mais frequente com os fãs. Para ampliar esse diálogo, a Ubisoft planeja realizar workshops fechados com integrantes da comunidade e criadores de conteúdo. Uma nova pesquisa também foi disponibilizada, enquanto a empresa incentiva os jogadores a acompanharem as oportunidades de participação pelo Discord oficial. Além dos projetos ainda não anunciados, a Ubisoft atualizou o andamento de dois jogos conhecidos da comunidade: Codename Invictus e Codename Hexe . Ambos continuam em desenvolvimento, mas seguem propostas diferentes dentro do universo de Assassin’s Creed . Invictus é um projeto multiplayer competitivo que passou por uma primeira sessão privada de testes com centenas de jogadores. Segundo a Ubisoft, o retorno foi positivo em relação ao parkour, à verticalidade dos mapas e ao trabalho em equipe, mas a equipe também recebeu pedidos para reforçar elementos tradicionais da franquia. Já o Codename Hexe promete uma experiência mais sombria dentro da série e continua em desenvolvimento. A empresa afirmou que ainda há trabalho pela frente e que pretende compartilhar uma nova atualização mais significativa sobre o projeto em 2027. A Ubisoft também reforçou que Black Flag Resynced recebeu sua última grande atualização recentemente , enquanto as equipes seguem trabalhando nos próximos projetos da saga de assassinos templários. stories.title: Xbox's Doom, Wolfenstein Developers Working 'More Closely Than Ever' Following Xbox 'Reset' Layoffs
stories.summary: Bethesda and Xbox development studio id Software, maker of the Doom franchise, has deepened its partnership with fellow Bethesda and Xbox studio MachineGames, makers of the most recent Wolfenstein games as well as 2024's Indiana Jones and the Great Circle.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Xbox's Doom, Wolfenstein Developers Working 'More Closely Than Ever' Following Xbox 'Reset' Layoffs
sources.text: Bethesda and Xbox development studio id Software, maker of the Doom franchise, has deepened its partnership with fellow Bethesda and Xbox studio MachineGames, makers of the most recent Wolfenstein games as well as 2024's Indiana Jones and the Great Circle. At a press event earlier this week for id Software's Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations DLC, which was released this summer, studio co-director Marty Stratton was asked how the studio is doing in the wake of the layoffs that affected id as part of Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's ongoing Xbox " reset ." He answered, "We're doing great. Not to handwave the [layoffs] away...everybody knows we had about half of our studio exit as part of that. But there was a very deliberate effort to make sure that we were incredibly viable coming out of that across everything we do, across game development and technology department. "We're working more closely with MachineGames than ever. We've always had a very close partnership with them, but I think we're at a point with technology development that both teams are incredibly talented and have incredibly talented engineers and we're really on an amazing path that had started pre-[layoffs]. We'd kicked this off earlier this year. We're really excited about that. We're both really really bullish on what we have ahead." This is purely speculative on my part, but might the two decorated first-person shooter studios be co-developing MachineGames's next project, which is heavily rumored to be Wolfenstein 3 – with studio head Jerk Gustafsson saying, "We're not done with Wolfenstein yet"? Not only has MachineGames used id Software's idTech engine for every one of its games, but Sharma has publicly stated that she wants Xbox's development teams to double down on their biggest franchises – a sentiment echoed by Bethesda boss Jill Braff. And with id now seemingly done with Doom: The Dark Ages following the oustanding Revelations DLC, a team-up with MachineGames might help get the rumored third Wolfenstein game out the door faster, and getting games out more quickly is one of Sharma's goals. In addition, while Doom should certainly be considered in that "biggest franchises" group, Wolfenstein most likely is as well. Plus, Amazon has a Wolfenstein TV series in development, which might further incentivize Xbox and Bethesda to pair up id and MachineGames to make sure the latter team's next game is as awesome – and out as quickly – as possible. Bu whatever either team does next, the project(s) will be highly anticipated, at least by me, as both teams have incredible track records, both historically and recently. Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: id Software co-director says the Doom developer is 'working more closely with MachineGames than ever' after Xbox laid off 'about half of our studio'
sources.text: MachineGames is rumoured to be working on a third Wolfenstein game. Id Software has tightened its relationship with fellow shooter specialists MachineGames according to studio co-director Marty Stratton, after Xbox laid off roughly half of the Doom developer's employees earlier this year. Stratton was asked how the studio was doing following Xbox's massive job cuts at a recent press event for Doom: The Dark Ages' Revelations DLC (via IGN ) and he was keen to assure everyone that things are hunky dory at the legendary FPS developer. "We're doing great," Stratton explained. "Not to handwave the [layoffs] away … everybody knows we had about half of our studio exit as part of that. But there was a very deliberate effort to make sure that we were incredibly viable coming out of that across everything we do, across game development and [the] technology department." As part of its response to those layoffs, id Software has apparently deepened its ties with MachineGames, developers of Wolfenstein: The New Order and, more recently, the excellent Indiana Jones and the Great Circle . "We're working more closely with MachineGames than ever," Stratton said. "We've always had a very close partnership with them, but I think we're at the point with technology development that both teams are incredibly talented and have incredibly talented engineers and we're really on an amazing path that had started pre-[layoffs]. We'd kicked this off earlier this year. We're really excited about that. We're both really, really bullish on what we have ahead. Stratton's comments have led to speculation that the two developers may be cooperating on Wolfenstein 3, which MachineGames is rumoured to be working on . Id Software has just concluded active development of Doom: The Dark Ages following the expansions' release, so this is possible. What's interesting to me, however, is how Stratton repeatedly references technology. The id Software layoffs heavily impact the developer's Frankfurt arm, including numerous designers of the formidable id-tech engine. This led to fears that id-tech was being shelved. Microsoft contradicted this, though further reports left the question open . But Stratton's comments lead me to believe we might be seeing a tech alignment between the two developers as a result of those Frankfurt layoffs. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. While id Software built Doom: The Dark Ages on id-tech 8, MachineGames used a modified version of id-tech 7, called Motor, for Indiana Jones and the Great Circle. The fact that Stratton references both teams' "incredibly talented engineers" suggests to me that id Software is folding MachineGames' engine programmers directly into id-tech's ongoing development, with both teams working on the engine concurrently going forward. Assuming that id tech hasn't been canned outright, this approach would make sense given the expertise id Software lost from its Frankfurt arm. Sadly, the layoffs that affected id Software were far from the last at Xbox. After cutting 1600 jobs in the summer, Xbox initiated a second wave of layoffs in September that also saw Obsidian and Bethesda merge and put Activision in charge of Halo. Further Xbox layoffs are planned leading up to January 2027, while Microsoft more broadly has offered a "voluntary exit offer" to over a quarter of its workforce. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Rick has been fascinated by PC gaming since he was seven years old, when he used to sneak into his dad's home office for covert sessions of Doom. He grew up on a diet of similarly unsuitable games, with favourites including Quake, Thief, Half-Life and Deus Ex. Between 2013 and 2022, Rick was games editor of Custom PC magazine and associated website bit-tech.net . But he's always kept one foot in freelance games journalism, writing for publications like Edge, Eurogamer, the Guardian and, naturally, PC Gamer. While he'll play anything that can be controlled with a keyboard and mouse, he has a particular passion for first-person shooters and immersive sims. As the corresponding pre-registration milestones are unlocked and the total number of followers across the game’s official global social media channels reaches each specified target, players wil lbe able to claim exciting rewards, including a new 4-star character and Simulation Shot (×20). Pre-registration milestone event rewards include: Here is an overview of the game, via Elementa: Silver Palace is an open-world action adventure RPG centered around detective mysteries. Step into a city of wonders and deception, where you will investigate bizarre and bewildering cases, forge bonds with an eclectic cast of companions, and write your own story beyond detective work, whether as a rising property magnate or a familiar face at a quaint little café. In Silvernia, every encounter is a choice: to mingle, to investigate, to judge, or to fight. New discoveries, strange encounters, and grand adventures await.

sources.title: Final Fantasy 14 Evercold gets a four week delay - the MMO expansion now arrives in a busy February
sources.text: Pre-orders open on World of Warcraft: Forever's release date Final Fantasy 14 : Evercold has received a short and swift four-week delay. Square Enix 's MMORPG expansion was originally set to release in January of next year, but an update from Final Fantasy Fan Fest Japan has revealed that it's now due to come out during the packed month of February, 2027. Final Fantasy 14 boss Naoki Yoshida - affectionately dubbed Yoshi-P by fans - revealed the news during FF14 Fan Fest Japan. Evercold's new release date is officially February 23, 2027 with an early access period beginning on February 19, 2027. Of course, February is already packed with mammoth games - everything from Fable, God of War: Laufey, Persona 4 Revival, and Metro 2039 are seemingly taking shelter from GTA 6 . Here's hoping you have a spare few dozen hours a week for all the incoming goodies. Evercold pre-orders begin on November 4, which is funnily enough the official release date of Final Fantasy 14's biggest rival: World of Warcraft Forever. ( I'm sure it's just coincidental .) Pre-order bonuses include a Kottr minion that's part of the expansion's new, fluffy, feline race, as well as a pair of earrings and early access. You can check out all the different editions over on the official website - be warned, the Final Fantasy 13 mount might tempt you to put a dent in your wallet. Evercold makes a ton of changes to the beloved, widely played online game. For one, a new Evolved system is promising to streamline ability hotbars and rejig the way jobs work. The game's also crossing over with the Final Fantasy 7 Remake series in a new Evercold raid. Final Fantasy 14's new typing minigame is already causing chaos as players struggle against bots and impossible words: "It just came out" Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week Kaan freelances for various websites including Rock Paper Shotgun, Eurogamer, and this one, Gamesradar. sources.title: Final Fantasy 14 Evercold Gets A Month Long Delay But An Awesome New Trailer
sources.text: Delay Evercold Final Fantasy XIV MMORPG Trailer There was good and bad news at Final Fantasy XIV ‘s Japan Fan Fest . The bad news was that the MMORPG’s new expansion Evercold has been delayed by about a month. Originally set for sometime in January, the full launch will now arrive on February 23, 2027. The good news is that Evercold now has its third and final teaser trailer, a six minute cinematic that sets up the narrative stakes for Final Fantasy XIV ‘s biggest update in nearly three years. “Tell me about the Promised Land,” a young girl asks early in the trailer. A wise old lady recalls a time of beauty and abundance that gave way to a “relentless ice” as magical beasts took over the mainland. People abandoned the continent for the skies above. The rest of the trailer is pretty much a ton of breathless views of massive city-sized airships (called Realmships) and cool battles showing off new job classes like the tanky Bastion who wields gunshields called Skyltborgs. Something that Square Enix doesn’t get enough credit for in its fantasy world building style is sneaking guns into stuff and making it look elegant and cool as hell. The trailer also showed off the new DPS class called Zephyr, which wields a cross bow and a neat bird companion. It received its own breakout trailer giving fans a quick lowdown on how it will work. In fact, there were a lot of trailers to come out of the Japan Fan Fest. We got another teaser for the Neon Evangalion crossover event coming in 2027 as well as deep dives into the new locations and other changes coming with version 8.0 in Evercold . It will give players plenty to chew on as they wait a month longer for the full release. Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 (there’s a trailer for the collector’s edition, too ). Those who pay for the pre-order (any edition) will get early access to the expansion starting Friday, February 19, 2027. While a four week delay isn’t a big deal, this does mean that February is now even more packed. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis , God of War Laufey , Persona 4 Revival , and Fable all come out within a week of Evercold ‘s early access window. Should be fun!
